summary: Enthusiastic early childhood educator with experience providing high-quality instruction and fostering a positive learning environment for young students. Skilled in curriculum development, classroom organization, and building trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and administrators.

experience.title: Preschool Teacher
bullets: Created lesson plans in accordance with state curriculum and school-wide curriculum standards.
Established positive relationships with students, colleagues and school administrators.
Strengthened communication with families by holding regular conferences.
Named Teacher of the Year by peers in 2015.

experience.title: Assistant Teacher
bullets: Supervised twenty students ages five to eight in a before and after school childcare setting.
Provided full-time summer camp care for ages five to eleven, including chaperoning weekly field trips.
Maintained first aid procedures and ensured student safety during transport and activities.

experience.title: Senior Support Representative
bullets: Served as resource for customer service and technical problems for eight on-line support technicians.
Troubleshot system issues and provided internal and external customer support via email.

experience.title: Customer Service Administrator
bullets: Created and maintained a Customer Service Training manual for an online classifieds company.
Provided internal and external customer service via e-mail and system troubleshooting.
